title: Code Factory: Proof-by-Sabotage Software Factory
description:
Code Factory is a proof-first, open-source software factory for turning specifications, behavior checks, design contracts, policy verification, Mermaid diagrams, and release receipts into auditable delivery through Unified Graph Ops. Version 0.40.1 adds IDE Health Flight Recorder, which retains bounded local aggregate heap, process-CPU-when-available, indexing, and EDT dispatch observations in the JetBrains plugin, plus Index Continuity Guard, which compares an explicit local structural baseline for manifest, source-root, managed-directory, and path-classification drift. Neither control changes IDE settings, invalidates caches, manipulates indexes, contacts a network service, attributes a symptom to a plugin, or predicts a duration or performance improvement. It retains hash-only LangGraph resume parity assurance and the offline-verifiable Survival Card for already recorded transition receipts. The local MCP surface and Graph Ops inspect existing receipts without gaining write or execution authority. Release media includes the current FactoryLine identity asset and real product captures.

Evidence boundary: IDE Health observations do not establish a runtime root cause, a plugin attribution, or a performance improvement. Index Continuity does not establish index corruption or repair. The project does not expose raw state, prompts, or secrets; grant execution outside a named admitted local E2E batch, repair, approval, merge, publication, deployment, signing, credential, connector, or external-message authority; or estimate time, token, cost, quality, or productivity savings. A passing receipt proves only the supplied sealed transitions and declared checks.
